description: Cs₂NaBiCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Cs is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent BiCl₆ octahedra. All Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.84 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form BiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Cl is bonded to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Bi atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ClCs₄NaBi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
